description: Full AI-consent report for a domain: robots.txt rules for each AI bot (training, search and user-agent crawlers), RSL license, IETF AIPREF Content-Usage, W3C TDMRep, noai meta tags, llms.txt and C2PA, combined into a 0-100 score and a training stance, plus a verifiable receipt (EAS attestation anchored on Base). Use it before crawling, training on or ingesting a site. Costs 0.005 USD in USDC via x402 (Base or Solana); without a payment it returns the x402 payment options. Unreachable sites are not charged.
